About us

One team, from plan to possession

JS Buildcore and Consultants is a Nagpur-based construction and design firm. We handle every stage of building your home or commercial space — planning, architectural and structural design, 3D elevation, plan sanction, construction and interiors — so you deal with one team from start to finish.

Good construction comes from careful planning, honest estimates and close site supervision. Every project is built to the approved drawings, with quality materials and regular updates for the owner.

  • Design to handover under one roof
  • Detailed estimates before work starts
  • Regular site supervision
  • Plan sanction assistance

FAQs

Questions we're often asked

What does the ₹1799/sq.ft. rate include?

It is our starting rate for construction with material. The final rate depends on the design, specifications and finishes you choose — we share a detailed, itemised estimate after the consultation. Terms & conditions apply.

Is the consultation really free?

Yes. Call, WhatsApp or fill in the enquiry form and we'll discuss your plot, requirements and budget at no charge.

Do you help with plan sanction?

Yes. We prepare the drawings and assist you through the building plan approval process.

Do you take renovation or interior-only projects?

Yes. Along with new construction we handle renovation, dismantling and interior designing.

Where are you located?

Our office is in Lakadganj, Nagpur. Share your site location and we'll confirm how we can help.
